title: Brandt residential lease, second-floor apartment, 27 Larkin Way
summary: This is a one-year lease for the second-floor apartment at 27 Larkin Way, running from June 1, 2027 to May 31, 2028, at $1,780 per month with a $1,780 deposit held in a separate account. The rent is fixed for the whole Term, and any change can only come in a written renewal offer delivered at least sixty days before the Term ends. The Resident pays electricity, gas, and internet; the Owner pays water, sewer, trash, and recycling. The Owner may take unpaid rent and damage beyond ordinary wear and tear out of the deposit and must send the balance with an itemized list within fourteen days of move-out. The Resident may end the lease at any time on sixty days written notice and owes no fee or further rent after the notice period. The Owner gives forty-eight hours written notice before entering, except where there is an immediate threat to safety or the building. The lease does not say who handles repairs to the home, and it does not say how a disagreement between the Owner and the Resident would be handled.
